title: Basic 1.21.1 Mods
description: Basic mods that can be added to or just used for a vanilla experience.
body:
# Basic 1.21.1 Mods
This Project contains basic mods for 1.21.1 (Fabric and NeoForge). For now I will only make Fabric and NeoForge packs but I may port the pack to other versions eventually.
### Main mods in the pack:
Appleskin
Continuity
Litematica(Fabric)/Forgematica(NeoForge)
Full Brightness Toggle
Sodium
Iris
Jade
JEI
Just Zoom
Simple Voice Chat
Xaero's Minimap and World Map
Optimization mods
and some more!!!
